EXPLANATION: Strong aliphatic C–H stretches (2926, 2880, 2972 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003) and a saturated ketone C=O near 1714 cm⁻¹ fit a cyclohexanone derivative. Multiple bands in the 1050–1150 cm⁻¹ region (1054, 1108, 1142 cm⁻¹) are consistent with an aliphatic C–O (ether) stretch, supporting a methoxy substituent. The CH2 deformation at 1458 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and ring-related modes in the 700–900 cm⁻¹ region further match a substituted cyclohexanone. Among candidates, 1 (methoxy-substituted cyclohexanone) best accounts for both the carbonyl and ether features.
